question: Which of the following elements is classified as a lanthanoid group element?
solution: The correct answer is __**Cerium**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Cerium** is classified as a **lanthanoid group element**, which belongs to the **f-block** of the periodic table. • The lanthanoid series consists of **15 elements** from **atomic numbers 57 to 71**, starting with **Lanthanum** and ending with **Lutetium**. • Cerium is the **second element** in the lanthanoid series and has an atomic number of **58**. • Lanthanoids are known for their **unique electronic configurations**, with electrons filling the **4f orbitals**. • Cerium is widely used in various applications, including **catalysis** (e.g., in automobile catalytic converters), **alloys**, and **glass polishing**.
